title: [Bug]: Not all PDUs return `output_watts`
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Issue Description

In `test_power_off_reboot.py` we assert that each PSU gets energy by measuring PDUs `output_watts`, however, not all PDUs return `output_watts`

### Results you see

`KeyError` for `pdu["output_watts"]`

### Results you expected to see

No KeyError

### Is it platform specific

generic

### Relevant log output

```shell
N/A
```

```shell
N/A
```
